AiProvider.Name: AI Provider
AiProvider.Hint: Choose your AI service. OpenAI/ChatGPT has a free tier. URL and model auto-fill when you change this.

ApiKey.Name: API Key
ApiKey.Hint: Your API key for the selected provider. Get one free at platform.openai.com. Stored locally, never shared.

ApiUrl.Name: API Endpoint URL
ApiUrl.Hint: Auto-filled for most providers. Only change this for local servers (Ollama, LM Studio) or custom endpoints.

ModelName.Name: AI Model
ModelName.Hint: Select a model for your chosen provider. Changes automatically when you switch providers.

UseEnvoyKeys.Name: Share ACE: Envoy API Keys
UseEnvoyKeys.Hint: If ACE: Envoy is installed, use its API provider settings instead of separate keys.

SystemPrompt.Name: System Prompt
SystemPrompt.Hint: Base system prompt for the AI. Customize the ACE personality.

GameSystem.Name: Game System
GameSystem.Hint: Which TTRPG system are you running? Helps ACE give accurate rules answers.

AutoSuggestions.Name: Proactive Suggestions
AutoSuggestions.Hint: Enable automatic dramatic suggestions based on scene context.

SuggestionInterval.Name: Suggestion Interval (seconds)
SuggestionInterval.Hint: How often to check for proactive suggestions when enabled.

MaxContextTokens.Name: Max Context Tokens
MaxContextTokens.Hint: Maximum tokens to include for scene/actor context.

MaxResponseTokens.Name: Max Response Tokens
MaxResponseTokens.Hint: Maximum length of AI responses (in tokens).

EnableCritFumble.Name: Crit/Fumble Detection
EnableCritFumble.Hint: Automatically detect critical hits and fumbles and offer table rolls.

EnableSurvivalTracker.Name: Survival Tracker
EnableSurvivalTracker.Hint: Show the survival tracker bar (meals, rest, scene count).

EnableStoryNotes.Name: Auto Story Notes
EnableStoryNotes.Hint: Silently append notable events (boss kills, rare items, level-ups) as bullet points to PC biography fields.

EnableFameSystem.Name: Party Fame & Deeds
EnableFameSystem.Hint: Track significant party accomplishments and inject fame context into NPC conversations so they know about the party's reputation.

EnableNarrativeTime.Name: Narrative Time Tracking
EnableNarrativeTime.Hint: Track approximate in-game day and time of day based on narrative cues, scene transitions, and rests. Advances day on rest, detects time keywords in narrations.

SyncSimpleCalendar.Name: Sync with Simple Calendar
SyncSimpleCalendar.Hint: When enabled and Simple Calendar is installed, ACE's narrative time stays in sync with Simple Calendar. Day advances, rests, and time changes push to Simple Calendar, and Simple Calendar changes update ACE's day counter.

EnableDocumentLibrary.Name: Document Library
EnableDocumentLibrary.Hint: Enable the document library for uploading PDFs, text files, and images as AI reference material. The AI uses relevant excerpts to inform responses about world lore, geography, NPCs, and monsters.

DocContextBudget.Name: World Knowledge Budget (chars)
DocContextBudget.Hint: Maximum characters of digested world knowledge to inject per AI prompt. Higher values give the AI deeper reference material but cost more tokens and may slow responses on local models. 0 = disabled. Recommended: 8000+. Future-proof: raise as your hardware and models improve.

EnableVisionImages.Name: Vision: Send Map Images
EnableVisionImages.Hint: When enabled, relevant map/image uploads are sent to vision-capable AI models alongside text. This allows the AI to 'see' maps and reference visual material. Uses more tokens. Off by default.

DebugMode.Name: Debug Mode
DebugMode.Hint: Enable verbose console logging for troubleshooting.

EnableSubtleRolls.Name: Subtle Rolls (Blind Checks)
EnableSubtleRolls.Hint: Enable blind skill checks with AI-generated narration. Players roll blind, GM sees the result, and AI generates 3 narration options to choose from.

SubtleRollSkills.Name: Subtle Roll Skills
SubtleRollSkills.Hint: Comma-separated dnd5e skill IDs for subtle rolls: ins,his,arc,rel,nat,prc,inv,sur,med. Remove any you don't want available.

SubtleRollAutoDetect.Name: AI Roll Suggestions
SubtleRollAutoDetect.Hint: AI proactively suggests when players should make skill checks (e.g. Perception near traps, Insight with deceptive NPCs). Suggestions go to GM only — GM must approve before players see anything.

Library.Title: Document Library
Library.DropHint: Drop files here or click to upload
Library.Formats: PDF, TXT, MD, PNG, JPG, WEBP
Library.EmptyHint: Upload PDFs, text files, or map images to give the AI reference material about your campaign world.
Library.ConfirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this document?
